description: This file defines a Redis-based grain storage provider for Orleans, implementing methods for reading, writing, and clearing grain state with Redis, including lifecycle management and key generation.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements a Redis-backed grain storage provider for Orleans, managing state serialization, key generation, connection lifecycle, and state operations.

methods.name: RedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Constructor initializes storage with provided options, serializer, lifecycle, and logger.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to the silo lifecycle events for initialization and shutdown.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes Redis connection and database.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state from Redis, deserializes data, and updates grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes and writes grain state to Redis, handling concurrency via ETag/version check.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or resets grain state in Redis, updating ETag for concurrency control.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and disposes the Redis connection asynchronously.

methods.name: DefaultGetStorageKey
methods.description: Generates a Redis key for a grain's storage based on service ID, grain ID, and grain type.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the specified grain state type using the activator.
